cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(cui_mesh_cpu_fixture C)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
enable_testing()
get_filename_component(CUI_SOURCE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../.." ABSOLUTE)
set(CUI_BUILD_NATIVE OFF CACHE BOOL "Portable fixture" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}" cui EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
add_executable(test_mesh_cpu "${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/unit/test_mesh_cpu.c")
target_link_libraries(test_mesh_cpu PRIVATE cui_software cui)
cui_warnings(test_mesh_cpu)
add_test(NAME mesh_cpu COMMAND test_mesh_cpu)
